issues.issue: Is there a viable internal flight alternative (relocation within Chile) that defeats the section 96 claim?
issues.applicant_position: Former military spouse who mistreated her would find and kill her if she returned; relocation is not safe.
issues.result_quote: The claim under section 96 of the IRPA is rejected.

issues.issue: Does the claimant face a risk of torture under section 97(1)(a), given no government involvement?
issues.applicant_position: Her former spouse is a military man who mistreated her, including attempted killing during sex.
issues.result_quote: Therefore the claim of a fear of torture under section 97 (1) a) is rejected.

issues.issue: Does the claimant face a risk to life or of cruel treatment under section 97(1)(b)?
issues.applicant_position: Fears her former spouse will kill her to keep his affair secret.
issues.result_quote: the claim under section 97 (1) b) of the IRPA is also rejected.
